name: Soligle
description: A solar-forged blade of blinding radiance. Soligle locks the battlefield under the full force of the sun — draining the enemy's stamina dry while its divine light cuts through every defense. None can hide in the shadow of its flare.

abilities.name: Solar Lockdown
abilities.description: Soligle ignites the solar lock — drains 4 Stamina from the enemy (true drain), ignores enemy defense for 2 turns, and grants +30 ATK for 2 turns from the solar surge. On each Solar Flare Crush hit, an additional 1.5 Stamina is burned from the enemy.

abilities.name: Blazing Wing Strike
abilities.description: Each hit of Solar Flare Crush drains 1.5 Stamina from the enemy — 3 hits, so 4.5 Stamina in total.

abilities.name: Solar Siphon
abilities.description: Solar Siphon: every point of Stamina Soligle drains from the enemy also restores 8 HP — the sun feeds on stolen energy. Solar Overheat: while the enemy has less than 1.5 Stamina (too exhausted to Attack), Soligle's damage is boosted by 20%.

special_move.name: Solar Flare Crush
special_move.description: Soligle supercharges with solar energy and unleashes 3 crushing blows — each strike burning through the enemy's stamina and cutting past all defenses with the raw force of the sun!
flavour_texts: 🔥 **Strike 2** — Solar energy burns through every shield!
💥 **SOLAR FLARE CRUSH** — the battlefield melts under divine radiance!
